acceptance_question: Does the Current Mao teaching path transform already-accepted knowledge into a coherent, minimal and exam-useful learner reasoning path without duplicating Chengfeng or creating ritual debt?

master_chain: why Marxism must be Sinicized and adapted to the times
Mao Zedong Thought as the first major theoretical achievement
formation and succession of the theory system of socialism with Chinese characteristics
handoff to Xi Jinping Thought for the New Era
whole_subject.strongest_attack: The strongest risk was that C05-C08 could collapse into a chronological list of theories and hats, while C06 could become a dense policy inventory. Fresh readback found that C05 is explicitly a navigation chapter, C06 organizes content by theoretical problem and policy role, and C07-C08 preserve core-view versus major-content and role-to-formulation boundaries. No rewrite would reduce learner operations without sacrificing useful discrimination.
negative_space: Chengfeng remains the continuous first-study surface on iPad/MarginNote.
The review does not promote every P0 fact into active recall or permanent Memory.
Dates, meetings, long normative formulations and low-discrimination detail remain source-primary unless later evidence activates them.
No additional Recall ritual is required after every Natural Unit.
Content-support richness is backend completeness, not a mandate to expose all detail in Projection.

criteria.problem_first: Each chapter begins from a real historical/theoretical problem rather than a heading list.
criteria.canonical_unit_integrity: Natural Unit identity/order remains Chengfeng-owned and is not reorganized by Xiao1000.
criteria.reasoning_chain: Problem -> answer -> relation/boundary -> next is semantically continuous where the chapter has multiple units.
criteria.cross_chapter_bridge: Each chapter closes into the next historical/theoretical problem instead of ending as an isolated summary.
criteria.exam_discrimination: Logic explicitly separates confusable roles such as object/dynamics/leadership/nature/future, 1949/1956, essence/mode, core view/major content, and first priority/core standpoint/basic requirement/fundamental method.
criteria.compression: Chapter compression reconstructs the causal/role chain rather than merely shortening prose.
criteria.minimality: No extra learner operation is required solely to satisfy schema or ritual completeness.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: general Marxist principles -> Chinese reality/traditional culture -> two integrations -> practice/theoretical innovation -> successive theoretical achievements
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could become an abstract slogan preface detached from later chapters.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because it asks why adaptation is necessary and ends by opening the first concrete achievement, Mao Zedong Thought.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: formation conditions/process -> theme and main contents -> living soul -> historical position
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could flatten formation stages and the living soul into independent memorization lists.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the asset distinguishes theme/content/method/historical position and defers detailed chronology.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: national conditions -> contradictions -> tasks/objects -> route/program -> road and Three Magic Weapons
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: High density of object, dynamics, leadership, nature and future creates hat-confusion risk.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the logic explicitly derives these roles from national conditions and separates each layer before precision.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: transitional society -> industrialization plus transformation -> differentiated transformation paths -> socialist system establishment
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could degrade into a Three Transformations timeline.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the current path explains why transition is necessary, why routes differ, and why 1956 changes system status.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: system established -> need for an independent Chinese construction path -> Ten Major Relationships/contradictions/industrialization -> achievements and lessons
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Three theoretical topics could look like an arbitrary list.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because they are explicitly unified as different answers to the same problem: how to build socialism from Chinese conditions.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: new international/historical/practical conditions -> recurring new problems -> successive theory-system achievements -> navigation into C06-C08 and the New Era
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Highest risk chapter: it can become a redundant theory-name timeline before the learner studies the actual theories.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because Current explicitly defines it as a navigation chapter, limits itself to formation conditions and succession identities, and defers each theory's internal content to later chapters.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: what socialism is/how to build it -> emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts -> socialist essence -> primary-stage conditions/basic line -> development/reform/market -> unification/international strategy -> historical position
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Highest internal-load risk: the canonical main-content unit contains many policies and could become a long inventory.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because Current organizes the density by role: national-condition starting point, overall line, development staging, reform/market mechanisms, then unification/external conditions; backend detail is not itself the learner sequence.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: changed governing environment -> what kind of party/how to build it -> three core representations -> governing/practical content -> cross-century theoretical position
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could incorrectly treat Three Represents as only a party-building slogan or mix its three core views with all major content.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because the asset makes that distinction the central learning problem and connects party advancement to governing practice.

chapter_dispositions.logic_spine: new structural development problems -> development still first priority -> people-centered standpoint -> comprehensive/coordinated/sustainable requirement -> overall planning method -> six practice domains -> handoff to New Era
chapter_dispositions.strongest_attack: Could turn four scientific-connotation roles and six major-content groups into two memorization lists.
chapter_dispositions.decision: KEEP because each of the four roles answers a different question and the six domains are explicitly a downstream application layer.

conclusion.note: This review accepts Learning Logic only. It does not accept Projection, Runtime, Evidence or User Validation, and it does not infer learner progress.
